sessions.title: Hiragana — vokal あいうえお
topics: 5 vokal dasar: あ(a), い(i), う(u), え(e), お(o)
Sistem tulis fonetik — 1 huruf = 1 suku kata
Hiragana = native Japanese words + grammar particles
Stroke order penting — tulis dari kiri atas, urut tertentu

sessions.title: Hiragana — baris か & さ
topics: か き く け こ (ka ki ku ke ko)
さ し す せ そ (sa SHI su se so — し dibaca 'shi' bukan 'si')
Dakuten (゛): か→が, さ→ざ — voiced versions

sessions.title: Hiragana — baris た & な
topics: た ち つ て と (ta CHI tsu te to — ち='chi', つ='tsu')
な に ぬ ね の (na ni nu ne no)
Yang aneh: つ(tsu) dan ち(chi) — irregular romanization

sessions.title: Hiragana — baris は & ま
topics: は ひ ふ へ ほ (ha hi FU he ho — ふ='fu', bilabial)
ま み む め も (ma mi mu me mo)
Particle は dibaca 'wa' (NOT 'ha') saat sebagai topic marker

sessions.title: Hiragana — baris や ら わ + ん
topics: や ゆ よ (ya yu yo — hanya 3 huruf!)
ら り る れ ろ (ra ri ru re ro — Japanese R: tap-flap, antara r dan l)
わ を ん (wa wo n) — を particle objek (read 'o' or 'wo')
ん = satu-satunya konsonan tunggal — selalu di akhir suku kata

sessions.title: Hiragana — voiced + yoon
topics: Dakuten (゛): が ぎ ぐ げ ご (ga-gi-gu-ge-go), ざ じ ず ぜ ぞ (じ='ji')
Handakuten (゜): ぱ ぴ ぷ ぺ ぽ (pa-pi-pu-pe-po)
Yoon (small や ゆ よ): きゃ(kya), しゅ(shu), ちょ(cho) — 33 combinations
Sokuon っ (small tsu): doubles consonant — がっこう (gakkou) school

sessions.title: Salam & sapaan
topics: おはようございます (ohayou gozaimasu — pagi formal)
さようなら (sayounara — selamat tinggal formal) / じゃあね (jaa ne — bye casual)

sessions.title: Perkenalan diri
topics: はじめまして (hajimemashite — first meeting)
わたしは___です (watashi wa ___ desu — I am ___)
よろしくおねがいします (yoroshiku onegaishimasu — please be kind/work well with me)

sessions.title: Angka 1-10
topics: いち, に, さん, し/よん, ご, ろく, しち/なな, はち, きゅう, じゅう
Number 4 = し OR よん (し avoided — homonym dengan death 死)
Number 7 = しち OR なな
Number 9 = きゅう (avoid く — homonym dengan suffering 苦)

sessions.title: Copula です/だ
topics: わたしはインドネシアじんです (Watashi wa Indonesia-jin desu)
Negative: じゃありません (jya arimasen) OR ではありません (formal)

sessions.title: Particle は (wa) — topic marker
topics: Marks topic of sentence (apa yang dibicarakan)

sessions.title: Particle か — question marker
topics: か at end = question (no inversion needed)
あなたはがくせいですか (Anata wa gakusei desu ka — apakah kamu siswa?)

sessions.title: Asal usul + kebangsaan
topics: ___ から来ました (___ kara kimashita — saya datang dari ___)
Negara: 日本(Nihon-Japan), インドネシア, アメリカ, 中国(Chuugoku-China)
Bahasa: 日本語(Nihongo), インドネシア語(Indoneshia-go)
私は___人です (___ jin desu — saya orang ___)

sessions.title: Angka 11-100
topics: Combinations: 31 = さんじゅういち, 99 = きゅうじゅうきゅう

sessions.title: Nomor telepon + alamat
topics: Nomor telepon: 0 dibaca ぜろ/れい (zero/rei)
Hyphens: の (no) — 090-1234-5678 = ぜろきゅうぜろのいちにさんよんの…
Alamat Japanese: prefecture → city → district → block

sessions.title: Review A1.1 + Jepang 4 pulau
topics: 4 pulau utama: 本州(Honshu), 北海道(Hokkaido), 九州(Kyushu), 四国(Shikoku)

sessions.title: Hangul (한글) — invention story
topics: Hangul invented 1443 by 세종대왕 (King Sejong the Great)
Scientific phonetic design — consonants shape vocal organs, vowels based on sky/earth/human
Designed to be learnable in DAYS, not months (UNIQUE writing system globally)
Linguo's edge: Korean writing fastest mastery vs Japanese (3 systems) or Mandarin (Hanzi)

sessions.title: Hangul vowels (모음)
topics: 10 basic vowels: ㅏ(a) ㅑ(ya) ㅓ(eo) ㅕ(yeo) ㅗ(o) ㅛ(yo) ㅜ(u) ㅠ(yu) ㅡ(eu) ㅣ(i)
Compound vowels: ㅐ(ae) ㅔ(e) ㅚ(oe) ㅙ(wae) ㅟ(wi) etc
Vowel rules: bright (ㅏㅗ) vs dark (ㅓㅜ) — affects conjugation later
Drill: read 아 야 어 여 오 요 우 유 으 이 — bisa hafal sesi 1!

sessions.title: Hangul consonants (자음)
topics: 14 basic: ㄱ(g/k) ㄴ(n) ㄷ(d/t) ㄹ(r/l) ㅁ(m) ㅂ(b/p) ㅅ(s) ㅇ(silent/ng) ㅈ(j) ㅊ(ch) ㅋ(k) ㅌ(t) ㅍ(p) ㅎ(h)
Tense (쌍자음): ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ — doubled, harder/sharper
Position determines sound: ㄱ at start = 'g', at final = 'k'
ㅇ silent at syllable start, 'ng' at final position

sessions.title: Syllable blocks (음절)
topics: Korean writes in SYLLABLE BLOCKS, not linear letters
한 = ㅎ + ㅏ + ㄴ (h + a + n)
Block always reads top-to-bottom, left-to-right within

sessions.title: Salam — greetings
topics: 안녕히 가세요 (annyeonghi gaseyo) — goodbye to person LEAVING
안녕히 계세요 (annyeonghi gyeseyo) — goodbye SAID BY person leaving

sessions.title: Perkenalan diri
topics: 저는 ___ 입니다 (jeo-neun ___ imnida) — formal: I am ___
저는 ___ 예요/이에요 — polite informal: I am ___
Use 예요 after vowel, 이에요 after consonant — phonetic rule
이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) — what's your name? casual

sessions.title: Honorific system — 존댓말 vs 반말
topics: Korean has 5+ politeness levels — EARLIEST in language learning

sessions.title: Polite informal ~아/어요
topics: 가다 (go) → 가요, 먹다 (eat) → 먹어요, 하다 (do) → 해요
Vowel rule: ㅏㅗ stems → ~아요, others → ~어요, 하 → 해
Question: same form + ↗ rising intonation: 가요?

sessions.title: Kebangsaan
topics: 인도네시아 사람이에요 (Indonesia saram iyeyo) — saya orang Indonesia
Korea 한국 hanguk, USA 미국 miguk, Japan 일본 ilbon, China 중국 jungguk
어느 나라 사람이에요? (eoneu nara saram iyeyo?) — orang mana?

sessions.title: Sino-Korean numbers (Hanja-derived)
topics: USED FOR: dates, money, phone numbers, minutes, 분
Identical to Chinese 一二三四五 origin — Sino-Korean heritage

sessions.title: Native Korean numbers
topics: USED FOR: counting things, age, hours (시), people
예: 한 시 (1 o'clock), 두 사람 (2 people), 스무 살 (20 years old)
Pre-noun shortening: 하나 → 한, 둘 → 두, 셋 → 세, 넷 → 네

CELL 15, row 4 column 3: Review Akumulatif A1.1. Lesson meaning: Quiz aksara: 22 huruf + 5 final; Sapaan & perkenalan; Kalimat nominal.
CELL 16, row 4 column 4: Mini-Project — Perkenalkan Diri dalam Ibrani. Lesson meaning: Script 10 kalimat: nama, asal, umur, hobi; Rekam audio 1 menit; Feedback pengucapan dari guru.
